title: Module 2 — Technical content generation output
description: Output envelope of 02-technical-content-generation. Narrative sections are grounded in the client's reference docs. Which sections are present depends on the request's scope_of_supply: alcance_tecnico and resumen_comercial are always written; plan_implantacion and the extra scope sections (repuestos, transporte, formacion, garantia, ...) appear only when their scope item is included.

plan_implantacion.description: Implementation plan. Present only when installation / commissioning / project_management is in scope.

repuestos.description: Spare-parts section. Present only when spare_parts is in scope.

transporte.description: Shipping/logistics section. Present only when shipping is in scope.

formacion.description: Training section. Present only when training is in scope.

garantia.description: Warranty section. Present only when warranty is in scope.

sections_generated.description: Scope-item keys the module wrote content for (traceability).

grounded_on.description: Optional list of reference-doc identifiers used to ground the generation (traceability).
